assessmentRaw.opportunity: University research labs must comply with strict regulations for chemical inventories and Safety Data Sheets (SDSs), which can be an administrative burden. A simple, lab-focused SaaS could reduce this workload and minimize compliance and audit risks.
assessmentRaw.whoPays: The Lab Manager or Principal Investigator (PI) at a university research lab would pay, likely using grant funds, to ensure compliance and avoid safety hazards and audit failures. This is an inference.
